tidbit: Did you know… one story this hour was carried by two different outlets in the last few hours.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
SpaceX is seeking $40 billion to purchase chips, with AMD, Google, and Marvell expanding their investments amid rising demand. Reported by TechOrange 科技報橘.
Anthropic launches Haiku 5.5, its cheapest and fastest Claude model yet, achieving a 72.4% OSWorld score and offering monthly API credits. Reported by Decrypt News.
Utah's governor signed an executive order mandating human-guided and accountable artificial intelligence use across state agencies. Confirmed by GovTech.
CrowdStrike, AWS, and Nvidia launched a cybersecurity accelerator with global applications and $1 billion in alumni funding. Reported by TradingView.
OpenAI rolled out GPT-6 with an interactive UI and faster web search capabilities in ChatGPT. Reported by iClarified.
Free every hour.
